description: Deterministic format and content checks derived from VBench quality dimensions and VideoWeaver output evaluation criteria. This is NOT an official rubric from either benchmark.

items.criterion: Video is MP4 container with H.264 video codec
items.check: ffprobe format_name contains 'mp4' and video codec_name is 'h264'

items.criterion: Video duration is between 15 and 30 seconds inclusive
Video depicts a sunset/sky scene as described in the prompt
items.check: Visual inspection or VLM-based content check (non-deterministic)

items.criterion: Video contains multiple distinct shots showing different sunset stages
items.check: Scene detection via scenedetect or frame analysis (non-deterministic)

items.criterion: Agent produced intermediate artifacts (images, video clips, or audio) before final merge
items.check: workspace/output or workspace/logs contains intermediate files

items.criterion: Agent trajectory contains at least one tool call to a media generation or processing capability

scoring.note: Final reward = weighted average of pillar pass rates. Format pillar is fully deterministic. Content pillar may use VLM (optional). Process pillar is deterministic from trajectory.
